svg.aria-label: Unified memory, in testing: 22 ms of GPU work per open-world frame measured with the game's data in video memory; loading screens and intro locked at 30 fps on the new direct memory path; 3,000 times less memory bookkeeping per frame on recorded gameplay; one command list per game command list again; 0.18 ms to answer any memory alias question; 121 million descriptor rows checked with zero errors.
